title: Authorize explicit contract evolution for constructed responses
purpose: Define the smallest explicit successor contract needed for a bounded constructed-response product slice without mutating the frozen learnit.kit.v2 meaning in place, without weakening the learner-safe UI boundary promoted by ATLAS-WP-025, and without introducing a generic activity runtime or nondeterministic scoring authority.
invariants: contracts/learnit-kit-v2.schema.json remains byte-unchanged and learnit.kit.v2 keeps exactly its existing qcm/fill meaning.
learnit.kit.v3 is opt-in and is a strict successor superset for new content; no existing v2 package is rewritten, migrated or re-digested by this work package.
The only new v3 activity family is constructed.
Constructed v1 accepts learner free text but uses only deterministic local canonical-text matching against authored acceptedResponses.
acceptedResponses are scoring secrets owned by Learning and must never cross the learner-safe UI presentation boundary.
The learner-safe presentation for constructed contains only type and prompt in the first product slice.
The learner response shape is exactly {text:string}; blank-after-normalization responses fail closed.
Canonical text normalization is NFC, trim, and collapse Unicode whitespace; comparison is case-sensitive and otherwise exact.
No remote AI, LLM, rubric engine, evaluator registry, plugin system, event bus, new persistent schema or new execution class is authorized here.
ATLAS-WP-026 remains blocked until this architecture work package is accepted and merged.
requiredEvidence: ARC-WP-022 is cited as the authority requiring a new architecture work package for any contract change.
The v2 schema blob is unchanged from sovereign main.
The v3 schema is syntactically valid Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema and differs from v2 only by contract identity plus the bounded constructed family.
A representative existing v2 payload remains a v2 payload and is not silently reclassified as v3.
A minimal valid constructed v3 activity requires acceptedResponses and rejects qcm/fill scoring-secret fields that do not belong to it.
The design explicitly separates ActivityPresentation -> ActivityResponse -> Evaluation and keeps acceptedResponses behind Evaluation.
Repository governance and PR scope pass on the exact architecture PR head.
adversarialTests: Any edit to contracts/learnit-kit-v2.schema.json fails scope.
Any product/runtime implementation in apps/** fails scope.
Any constructed schema that permits acceptedResponses to be presented as learner UI data fails the boundary review.
Any network-dependent or nondeterministic scoring rule fails this work package.
Any generic evaluator registry or activity-runtime abstraction fails the anti-complexity gate.
Any implicit migration or rewriting of existing v2 packages fails compatibility review.
Any second new activity family fails scope.
nonGoals: Implementing constructed response in Learn-it Next.
Updating authoring Studio or AI Kit Factory.
Changing qcm/fill behavior or existing v2 validators.
Defining rubric, semantic, LLM or human-review scoring.
Changing planner, evidence, memory, storage or recommendation semantics.
Repairing the generic Learn-it Next CI router.
independentReview: The main alternative, mutating learnit.kit.v2 in place, is rejected because ARC-WP-022 froze that contract and older v2 readers would reject newly-valid v2 constructed payloads.
An internal-only constructed activity is rejected because it would not prove the real kit -> import -> learner path.
A generic evaluation object is deferred because the first observed need is one deterministic text matcher, not an evaluator framework.
A successor discriminator keeps old kits stable while making capability negotiation explicit.
rollback: Close the architecture PR and delete its branch. Sovereign main, frozen learnit.kit.v2, promoted ATLAS-WP-025 seam and all learner data remain unchanged.
